start.title: HACKER DEFENSE
start.subtitle: Protect your bank account from cyberattacks
start.spaceHint: SPACE → Critical Strike • Click → Collect Data

tutorial.step1Desc: Your bank account has $10,000. If hackers reach it, they'll steal your money! Build towers to stop them.
tutorial.step2Desc: Place towers on the green circles. The Password Tower shoots, Antivirus slows and reveals phishing, and the 2FA Wall blocks enemies.
tutorial.step3Desc: Viruses are fast, Trojans are tough, Phishing goes in disguise (click them to reveal!), and the Boss The Scammer creates annoying popups.
tutorial.step4Desc: When your towers shoot, press SPACE for a Critical Strike that doubles damage. Also collect the falling data packets!
tutorial.actionCommandHint: Double damage when the indicator glows

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.subtitle: Identify if this message is phishing before the attack begins
inbox.correct: Correct! Great eye for detecting threats.
inbox.wrong: Watch out! That was a trick.

email1.subject: ⚠️ URGENT: Your account is locked
email1.body: Hello! We are National Bank. Your account has been locked due to suspicious activity. You must verify your identity NOW by clicking the link:
email1.explain: Clues: suspicious '.ru' domain, urgency language, real banks never ask you to click links via email.

email2.subject: Your March statement is ready
email2.body: Your monthly March account statement is now available in the app. You can view it directly from your mobile app or official online banking.
email2.link: Access from your official app at bankofamerica.com
email2.explain: Correct: real banks don't ask for urgent data, don't include third-party links, and direct you to their official app.

email3.subject: 🏆 Congratulations! You won $50,000 — claim in 24 hours
email3.body: You have been selected as the winner of our lottery! To claim your prize we need your account number and password to transfer the money. It's URGENT, you only have 24 hours!
email3.explain: Classic phishing: fake prize promise, requests bank data, artificial urgency. Nobody wins prizes without entering.

map.buildHint: Build and upgrade towers before the next attack

twoFA.title: WALL UNDER ATTACK!
twoFA.subtitle: Type the code to restore the wall

bossPopup.body1: You won an iPhone 15 Pro. Click to claim your prize NOW.
bossPopup.body2: Double your money in 24 hours. We just need your account number.
bossPopup.body3: Your system is infected. Call 800-SUPPORT to clean your PC now.

upgrade.title: Password Forge
upgrade.subtitle: Create a strong password to upgrade your tower. Select one of each type.
upgrade.hint: A good password uses all 4 types of characters

levelResult.rankS: Perfect defense! You're a cybersecurity expert.
levelResult.rankB: Good try. Some attacks got through.
levelResult.rankC: You need to strengthen your defenses.

gameOver.title: ACCOUNT EMPTIED
gameOver.subtitle: Hackers stole all your money
gameOver.tip: Tip: Build Antivirus towers to detect Phishing and use the 2FA Wall to stop large waves.

victory.title: SYSTEM PROTECTED!
victory.subtitle: You successfully defended against all 3 levels of cyberattacks
